summary: Enforce cross-trap invariants that prevent a Proxy from lying incompatibly about non-configurable target properties.

source.pattern: Proxy operation touching non-configurable own property

target.notes: Use the JavaScript object-model runtime. Proxy semantics require trap lookup, handler calls, target internal methods, revocation checks, and invariant enforcement.

semantics.protected_properties: non-configurable own properties cannot be hidden by has/getOwnPropertyDescriptor/ownKeys/deleteProperty
semantics.fixed_data: non-configurable non-writable data value constrains get/set trap results using SameValue
semantics.fixed_accessor: non-configurable accessor with missing getter/setter constrains get/set results
semantics.descriptor_changes: defineProperty/getOwnPropertyDescriptor cannot invent incompatible non-configurable state

caveats: Do not model Proxy as a plain C# decorator or Dictionary wrapper; observable internal-method interception and invariants must be preserved.
references: ECMAScript 2026 §6.1.7.3 Invariants of the Essential Internal Methods

tests.name: get cannot lie about fixed data value
has cannot hide non-configurable property
tests.input: const t={};Object.defineProperty(t,'x',{value:1,configurable:false});const p=new Proxy(t,{has(){return false}});try{console.log('x' in p)}catch(e){console.log(e instanceof TypeError)}
